en: John 16

p.src: 1  “I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.

en: “I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.

p.src: 2  They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time is coming that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.

en: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time is coming that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.

p.src: 4  But I have told you these things so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.

p.src: 7  Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away; for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.

en: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away; for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.

p.src: 8  When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;

p.src: 9  about sin, because they don’t believe in me;

en: about sin, because they don’t believe in me;

p.src: 10  about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won’t see me any more;

p.src: 12  “I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.

en: “I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.
u.src: 12  “I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.

p.src: 13  However, when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.

en: However, when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.

p.src: 14  He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine and will declare it to you.

en: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine and will declare it to you.

p.src: 15  All things that the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine and will declare it to you.

en: All things that the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine and will declare it to you.

p.src: 16  “A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”

en: “A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”
u.src: 16  “A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”

p.src: 17  Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;’ and, ‘Because I go to the Father’?”

en: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;’ and, ‘Because I go to the Father’?”

p.src: 18  They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while’? We don’t know what he is saying.”

en: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while’? We don’t know what he is saying.”

p.src: 19  Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me’?

en: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me’?

p.src: 20  Most certainly I tell you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.

en: Most certainly I tell you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.
u.src: 20  Most certainly I tell you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.

p.src: 21  A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.

en: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.
u.src: 21  A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.

p.src: 22  Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.

en: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.

p.src: 23  “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.

en: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.
u.src: 23  “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.

p.src: 24  Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.

en: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.

p.src: 25  “I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.

en: “I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
u.src: 25  “I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.

p.src: 26  In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you that I will pray to the Father for you,

en: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you that I will pray to the Father for you,

p.src: 27  for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.

en: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.
u.src: 27  for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.

en: I came from the Father and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world and go to the Father.”

p.src: 32  Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
